name: Respecting Parents
overview: Scripture commands believers to honor and respect their parents as a divine mandate, promising that such obedience leads to a prolonged and prosperous life in the land God provides (Exodus 20:12; Deuteronomy 5:16). The seriousness of this command is underscored by the severe consequences for cursing parents (Exodus 21:17) and the need for correction of rebellious children who refuse parental authority (Deuteronomy 21:18). Wisdom literature further emphasizes the value of heeding parental instruction and the loving discipline that parents must exercise to guide their children rightly (Proverbs 1:8; Proverbs 13:24).
